title: Retained evidence coverage
caption: Counts share the 925-upload index denominator. English caption pilot coverage is a selected analysis subset, not an estimated availability rate. Known duration means positive duration; date means exact indexed date.

title: Concentration of indexed uploads
caption: 886 attributed uploads across 180 nonempty publishing-account groups; 39 unresolved uploads are excluded from this account concentration denominator and retained elsewhere. Empty account routes are excluded. This is index composition, not YouTube-wide concentration.

title: Duration of the selected caption pilot
caption: Positive-duration uploads only: caption pilot n=30, other uploads within pilot publishing accounts n=430, all other indexed uploads n=851. The two comparator sets overlap. Bars are empirical interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals. No selection mechanism or population inference is estimated.

title: Title keyword indicators by duration band
caption: 702 English-likely eligible titles with positive measured duration. Cells are title-level shares matching at least one transparent topic regex; categories overlap and are unvalidated. Length bands are not manually verified upload-format labels. Titles describe publishing language, not necessarily speech or answers.

title: Publisher association in matched text representations
caption: Identical 25 uploads from 14 publishing accounts support both panels; 11 accounts have within-account pairs and three are singletons. Boxplots show empirical medians/IQRs and whiskers at 1.5 IQR, not confidence intervals. Pair scores share uploads and are dependent. Vectors are retained MiniLM derivatives; no new model execution or speech validation.

title: Publisher-label negative control
caption: 2,000 fixed-seed publisher-label permutations on the same 25 vectors preserve publisher group sizes and destroy their observed associations. The reference is a descriptive diagnostic, not a population p-value, semantic validity test, or experimental effect. Cosine scales differ between title and caption representations.
